I'm checking the month_start format and filtering by local_date, and I'll return null if there's no data. messages.content:
In August 2026, about **22,053 kWh** (22,052.548) of the plant's consumption wasn't covered by the four department meters. That's roughly 5% of the site total.

I took the site meter's total for the month and subtracted the four department meters:

| Meter | Aug 2026 (kWh) |
|---|---|
| Site total | 444,344.712 |
| Stamping (dept_a) | 185,438.055 |
| Painting (dept_c) | 123,989.915 |
| Welding (dept_b) | 91,418.978 |
| Assembly (dept_d) | 21,445.216 |
| **Not covered by departments** | **22,052.548** |

All five meters have a full month of readings, from 1 to 31 August by local date.

The solar array and battery have their own meters outside the department tree. I didn't include them in the calculation. I also assumed the site meter shows the plant's total consumption. If it actually shows grid import after solar and battery, the uncovered amount would be different.
